statusLine.command: jq -r 'def nonnegative: if type == "number" and . >= 0 then . else null end; def clean: tostring | explode | map(select(. >= 32 and (. < 127 or . > 159))) | implode; def compact: if . == null then "--" elif . >= 1000000 then ((. / 100000 | round) / 10 | tostring) + "M" elif . >= 1000 then ((. / 100 | round) / 10 | tostring) + "k" else (floor | tostring) end; . as $session | ($session.context_window // {}) as $context | ($context.context_window_size | nonnegative) as $size | (if ($context.current_usage | type) == "object" then [$context.current_usage.input_tokens, $context.current_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, $context.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens] | map(nonnegative) | if all(. == null) then null else add end elif $context | has("current_usage") then null else $context.total_input_tokens | nonnegative end) as $used | (($context.remaining_percentage | nonnegative) // (if ($context.used_percentage | nonnegative) != null then 100 - $context.used_percentage elif $used != null and $size != null and $size > 0 then 100 - 100 * $used / $size else null end)) as $remaining | (($session.workspace.current_dir // $session.cwd // $session.workspace.project_dir // "?") | clean | split("/") | map(select(length > 0)) | last // "/") as $dir | (($session.model.display_name // $session.model.id // "Claude") | clean) as $model | (($session.effort.level // "") | clean) as $effort | [$dir, ($model + if $effort == "" then "" else " (" + $effort + ")" end), (if $remaining == null then "--% context left" else ([$remaining, 100] | min | [., 0] | max | floor | tostring) + "% context left" end), (($used | compact) + "/" + ($size | compact) + " tokens")] | join(" · ")'
